anata uses the basic principles of customer web interaction to help our clients achieve increased page engagement and conversions

our process.

The anata team focuses and the things that make the largest impact on traffic enagament and conversions.

Keyword Research

With simple research on customer search trends and competitor site audit, we are able to pull relevant and high traffic search terms that will provide relevant and searchable content.

Page Audit

Through your products and services we determine whether or not the keywords used on your determined pages will provide the most sufficient search results and bring your site the most relevant traffic.

Integration

Components on your site should be well thought out and provide an experience to your customers as well as being sufficient to your teams work flow.

Competitor Research​

A deep analysis of your competitors will allow the our team to deeply understand your markets demographic and landscape. We us this information to provide our clients a better understanding of the path they should take to maximize their success.

Technical Audit​

A behind the scenes analysis of your back end system to help determine how we can increase page speed and over site visibility in search consoles.
